title: Canotto Lab export
description: What the app downloads. A full backup carries everything; a recipes or log download carries only that collection.

$schema.description: Points back at this file, so an export says what it is.

settings.description: Display and model preferences. Not needed to read the data.

unit.description: Display only. Stored temperatures are always Celsius.

refTempC.description: One fermentation unit is one hour at this temperature.

q10Warm.description: Rate multiplier per 10 degrees, at and above the cold break.

q10Cold.description: Steeper multiplier below it, because a fridge slows dough more than one Q10 predicts.

k.description: Inoculation times fermentation units at ripeness. Anchored to the house protocol and recalibratable from a bake log.
